item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Security forces continue search operations in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch and Mendhar districts while a 29-year-old woman was injured in a bear attack in the region. In Manipur, 84 BSF personnel were hospitalised with food poisoning after a morning meal and a Kuki-Zo woman was killed and her husband wounded in an ambush by suspected Naga militants in Kamjong, leaving two civilians missing. Leaders of the Cockroach movement remain jailed for violating a protest-site ban and protesters are bypassing internet blackouts with Bluetooth. 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
